entities.name: Users
entities.rationale: Three stick figures drawn on the far left of the whiteboard, left of the dashed vertical line; the middle one has an arrow to the left EC2 icon.

entities.name: EC2 (client/edge)
entities.rationale: Orange EC2 icon labelled 'EC2' on the left of the dashed vertical divider, next to the users. Not inside any box.

entities.name: AD
entities.rationale: Green icon labelled 'AD' (Active Directory) at bottom centre, right of the dashed vertical line. Receives a curved arrow from the left EC2.

entities.name: EMR
entities.rationale: Orange icon labelled 'EMR' at centre, right of the dashed vertical line; arrow towards S3.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Orange/red icon labelled 'S3' at centre-right; receives arrow from EMR, has arrow up to KMS and a curved arrow coming from the lower right.

entities.name: RDS
entities.rationale: Blue icon labelled 'RDS' at top centre, right of the dashed vertical line; curved line links it with the KMS box.

entities.name: KMS
entities.rationale: Text 'KMS' drawn inside a hand-drawn rectangle at top right; no icon, just a labelled box. Connected to S3 and RDS.

entities.name: EC2 (lower right)
entities.rationale: Second orange EC2 icon labelled 'EC2' at bottom right, right of the dashed vertical line, beside AD. No clearly drawn line attached to it; the curved arrow into S3 starts nearby on the right.

visual_connections.description: Straight green arrow from the middle stick figure to the left EC2 icon.
Curved green arrow from the bottom of the left EC2 down and right, crossing the dashed line, to the AD icon.
Straight green arrow from EMR pointing right to S3.
Curved green arrow from the top of S3 up to the KMS box.
Curved green arrow from the bottom-left of the KMS box towards the RDS icon; arrowhead appears to be at the RDS end.
Curved green arrow rising from the lower-right area into the right side of S3; its origin is not clearly attached and is assumed to be the lower-right EC2 (uncertain).
